notes:
VP Studio 0.124.

Highlights since the last release: the machine, in Studio - the Machine block shows and controls the VP-series controller (speeds, feeder mode, halt/clear), and runs can now start and stop the machine automatically with configurable sequences, plus a Pause/Resume that keeps the job open. Drive faults and warnings are reported by name, warnings without stopping the machine, and everything the machine does is kept in a date-stamped history (History button on the machine block). Dealer page with ordering, quotes and license requests from inside Studio; supplies catalog and ink profiles update themselves; segmented license key entry; Stamps.com postage tab (add-on licence); signed uninstaller with full-removal options; Help > Diagnostics.
